oracle_cmd: tshark -r rd_pcap_redirect_cname.pcap -Y http.response -T fields -E separator=/t -e http.request_in -e http.response.code -e http.location ; tshark -r rd_pcap_redirect_cname.pcap -Y 'dns.flags.response==1' -T fields -E separator=/t -e dns.qry.name -e dns.cname -e dns.a ; tshark -r rd_pcap_redirect_cname.pcap -Y 'tcp.flags.syn==1 && tcp.flags.ack==0' -T fields -e ip.dst -e tcp.dstport ; tshark -r rd_pcap_redirect_cname.pcap -Y http.request -T fields -E separator=/t -e frame.number -e http.request.full_uri  -> 3xx rows give hops; a declared https url with no request to its host counts as fetched when a SYN dst is one of its DNS answers
